name: DMC Perle Cotton #5 (working estimate)
note: Working orientation for simulator defaults until the owner photographs #5 with scale / microscope. Architecture must not depend on these being exact: replace w (and h if a side shot is available) when measured. Numbers are estimates / analogues, not measured-on-#5 facts.

w_mm.basis: TK-GAUGE: DMC Perle 5 — 7 strands = 0.5 cm (same page notes ~10 rows ≈ 7.5 mm → 0.75 mm as a cross-check)

hw.basis: Prior analogue cross-section ~0.71×0.46 mm (docs_thread-over-thread); NOT measured on Perle #5

tex.basis: Catalog: 25 m / 5 g (DMC / Olympus / Cosmo #5) → 200 tex

mu.basis: PHYS-COTTON-MU: cotton yarn order of magnitude; NOT Perle #5

mu_range.basis: PHYS-COTTON-MU published band for cotton yarn (annotation); order of magnitude only

compress.basis: model/spec.md T3/T4 — analogue compression laws only; no #5 numbers

provisionalLift.note: Prior synthesis only — NOT a geometric law. Do not hard-code into path builders; display/mechanics may use later when calibrated.

delta_h_mm.basis: Prior thread-over-thread synthesis (~1 N crossing rise); uncertainties P5

L_tent_order.basis: Tent lift half-span order-of-magnitude (sphere lift-off ~√(2RΔ)); estimate

replaceWhen: Owner photographs Perle #5 with scale (laid width) and, if possible, microscope / side shot for height h.
